CustomField.formula:
IF( Has_Work_Order__c,
IF( ISBLANK(Work_Order_Completion_Date__c), NULL,
( Work_Order_Completion_Date__c - CreatedDate ) * 1440
-
IF( ISBLANK(Pending_Customer_Start__c), 0,
( IF( OR( ISBLANK(Pending_Customer_End__c), Pending_Customer_End__c > Work_Order_Completion_Date__c ), Work_Order_Completion_Date__c, Pending_Customer_End__c ) - Pending_Customer_Start__c ) * 1440 ) ),
IF( ISBLANK(ClosedDate), NULL,
( ClosedDate - CreatedDate ) * 1440
-
IF( ISBLANK(Pending_Customer_Start__c), 0,
( IF( OR( ISBLANK(Pending_Customer_End__c), Pending_Customer_End__c > ClosedDate ), ClosedDate, Pending_Customer_End__c ) - Pending_Customer_Start__c ) * 1440 ) ) )
CustomField.label: MTTR Minutes
